narrative.details:
Because you fought with such valor and perseverance in the Battle of Hillsbrad, I have written this commendation, extolling your heroics in combat for the high command to recognize.

Take this sealed commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.  Go with pride, champion.
narrative.objectives: Take Darthalia's Sealed Commendation to Varimathras in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
So you are the infamous Champion who struck such a decisive blow against the Alliance forces in the Hillsbrad Foothills? Word of your glorious exploits traveled quickly to the Undercity.

You have quite a future in the Dark Lady's ranks if you continue to show such leadership and expertise in battle.

While our primary threat is the Lich King's Scourge army descending from the north, the human "problem" continues to impede our battle plans. You, however, have shown that the humans can and will fall.
narrative.requestItemsText: What brings a Champion all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?

quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Hillsbrad Farmhands, 6 Hillsbrad Farmers, Farmer Ray and Farmer Getz and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.objectiveText: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths. Retrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.objectiveText: Kill Magistrate Burnside and 4 Hillsbrad Councilmen.

quests.objectiveText: Kill Foreman Bonds and 10 Hillsbrad Miners and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Battle of Hillsbrad
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Dun Garok and kill 8 Mountaineers, 4 Riflemen, 2 Priests and Captain Ironhill and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
